styles.name: skyscraper
styles.description: Glass towers top out one by one across a skyline; lit windows twinkle, beacons blink, a crane swings on the tower going up

styles.name: suspension-bridge
styles.description: Red pylons and a sagging main cable; the deck is launched span by span with suspenders, a car crosses, water ripples below

styles.name: gothic-arch
styles.description: Pointed lancet arches rise bay by bay on pinnacled piers, then fill with shimmering stained glass

styles.name: brick-wall
styles.description: Red bricks in running bond are laid one by one, course by course, while a trowel taps the newest brick into its mortar bed

styles.name: pyramid
styles.description: Three stepped sandstone pyramids rise course by course under a desert sun; sunlit and shadowed faces, gold capstone

styles.name: scaffolding
styles.description: Steel standards, ledgers, timber boards and cross braces go up bay by bay, lift by lift; a bucket is hoisted on the newest bay

styles.name: geodesic-dome
styles.description: A triangulated geodesic hemisphere assembles band by band from the base up; light glints across its hubs

styles.name: spiral-staircase
styles.description: Looking down a stairwell: treads are laid along a spiralling brass handrail down to the newel post; the view slowly turns

styles.name: roman-aqueduct
styles.description: Two tiers of round stone arches advance across a river, with the water channel on top flowing as each span is finished

styles.name: classical-column
styles.description: Ionic columns rise drum by drum on a stepped base, gain scrolled capitals, then carry the entablature; sunlight sweeps the marble

styles.name: blueprint
styles.description: Blueprint drafted: graph grid first, then walls, windows, and dimensions

styles.name: tower-crane
styles.description: A lattice tower crane with counterweight and trolley hoists steel beams while the building beside it rises floor by floor

styles.name: colosseum
styles.description: Three tiers of travertine arches under a windowed attic rise left to right, the far end broken in a ruined profile
